turn_in_place.weapon_evidence: No per-frame weapon state in NAVDEMO; absent metadata remains unknown. Rotation rate is not a weapon label.

split.algorithm: random.Random shuffle within sorted families and episode identifiers; round(0.2*n) test per family
split.scope: episode holdout; routes/NPCs may overlap; original source split is retained in identifiers

method.frame: yaw=0 points world +X, right=+Z, up=+Y; rotate displacement by interval-start yaw; yaw errors wrap to [-180,180)
method.fit: componentwise median on free training intervals; no validation targets enter any table
method.support: supported at every available safety frame in the closed interval; body flags at available NAVDEMO endpoints and physical flags within interval; final full interval has only its start NAVDEMO sample
method.free: supported, no body/physical exceptional flags, max available endpoint slope <10deg, water depth <=10cm, outside +/-500ms jump/climb neighborhood, known block reference and no probable block
method.block_reference: training terrain-candidate horizontal displacement p75 per current-key+age; fallback current-key p75
method.probable_block: movement key held, reference >=2cm/100ms, actual horizontal displacement <50% reference; slow animation transitions can also trigger this proxy
method.mask_caveat: same frozen reference/mask for histories 0..3; uses observed displacement to condition evaluation, so free-only accuracy is optimistic and is not a deployable collision detector
method.buckets: overlap; max available endpoint slope; water depth>10cm, deep depth+1cm>=native threshold; jump/climb actions or native physical flags (also NAVDEMO climbing) dilated +/-500ms
method.rollout: all overlapping 1/3/10s windows with every step free and predicted; true initial position/yaw, actual pre-window key history; rotate next displacement by predicted yaw, no teacher pose correction
method.nonstationary: additional summaries require recorded horizontal path >=1cm per step/window; stationary windows remain in the primary summaries
method.history_selection: report all 0..3; history 3 fixed in advance for failure buckets, no test-based tuning
limits: Tables reproduce observed root-motion-plus-physics displacement, not isolated animation root motion.
This measures neither Jolt CharacterVirtual nor the accuracy after replacing physics.
Body flags are sampled at 100ms; physical logs add substep support, jump/climb, air and water evidence.

table.packed_key: age_bin + 8*(current_code + 55*prev1 + 55^2*prev2 + 55^3*prev3); truncate history to level; level -1=current_code only
table.initial_history: missing previous decisions=54; first decision age=0
table.lookup: requested history down to 0 (with age), then -1; unseen current keys remain unpredicted
